risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: The company is exposed to competitive risks in the home warranty and home services sector, which could affect its market share and revenues.

risks.title: Trade Tariffs and Regulations
risks.summary: Proposed or imposed U.S. import tariffs increase the cost of spare parts and household appliances, reducing margins and competitiveness.
risks.score_rationale: Changes in U.S. import tariffs and new trade restrictions increase the cost of parts and household appliances (Item 7, MD&A) (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on Contractors
risks.summary: The company is exposed to risks related to reliance on contractor entrepreneurs, which could affect service quality and availability.
risks.score_rationale: The company heavily relies on its network of contractor entrepreneurs for service delivery, which could affect quality and availability (Item 1A, Risk Factors) (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Weather Conditions and Seasonality
risks.summary: Weather conditions and seasonality significantly impact demand for home warranty services and financial results.
risks.score_rationale: Demand for services and financial results are affected by weather conditions and seasonal variations, particularly for HVAC service requests (Item 7, MD&A) (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Labor Availability and Costs
risks.summary: The company is exposed to risks related to the availability of skilled labor and rising labor costs, which could affect its operations.
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on its ability to attract and retain qualified employees and faces challenges related to labor availability (Item 1A, Risk Factors) (default score, to be refined)
